title: Rust Playground Offline
summary: A complete offline developer-learning environment composed from everything taught across the three tracks — this application is its reference architecture.
requirements: Lesson system with markdown rendering from embedded content
Rust compiler integration behind a sandboxed execution service
Test runner scoped to managed workspaces
Structured run output and educational diagnostics
Progress tracking with declarative prerequisite unlocks
Student notes and bookmarks persisted locally
Quizzes and code challenges per lesson
Code smell challenges following the Problem→Bad→Analysis→Refactor model
Local SQLite persistence through versioned migrations
features: Reuses the layered architecture documented in docs/architecture.md
Pinia-only state layer; Vuex remains tutorial text only
Execution sandbox with timeout/cancellation/isolation from Track 3 + Rust Module 5/6
Learning engine unlock matrix from Rust Module 4 concepts
Vue Router guards + lazy chunks from Vue Module 3
